## Onboarding Checklist

- [ ] Account Approved in Supabase (credit balance = 0)
- [ ] App downloaded & installed
- [ ] Gatekeeper bypassed on macOS
- [ ] API key configured and tested (infinite symbol ∞ shows)
- [ ] Local Obsidian Vault linked
- [ ] AI features verified working
